verdict.rationale: Workflow automation is a fair axis for an HR and payroll platform, but the evidence shows no user-definable rule or trigger-action engine. The closest items are a toggle to auto-sync Xero invoices the day after processing and built-in automatic holiday designation. These are fixed, adjacent behaviors, not rules a user defines to fire actions on events.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
